p0, p1 = 0.25, 0.75
assert abs((p0 + p1) - 1.0) < 1e-9

N = 1000
expected_0 = N * p0
expected_1 = N * p1

print(expected_0, expected_1)

caption: A real device measuring this exact state 1000 times might report 243/757 — pure statistical noise.

code:
def plot_expected_counts(probs, labels, n_shots):
  assert abs(sum(probs) - 1.0) < 1e-6
  expected = [n_shots * p for p in probs]
  fig, ax = plt.subplots()
  ax.bar(labels, expected)
  return fig, ax
caption: plot_expected_counts([0.1, 0.9], ["0","1"], 500) gives expected counts of 50 and 450.
